description:
The memory-first coding agent

Letta Code is a memory-first coding harness, designed for long-lived agents that can learn from experience.
Instead of working in independent sessions, you work with a persisted agent whose memory is portable across models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, Kimi, and more).
What's Changed
- fix(headless): derive ephemeral tools from conversation model by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/3871
- fix(tools): contain background output write failures by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/3873
- perf(skills): avoid request-time filesystem scans by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/3872
- fix(listener): pair split sockets across reconnects [LET-11074] by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/3880
- chore: bump version to 0.30.25 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/3874
Full Changelog: https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/compare/v0.30.24...v0.30.25
